fn-reading-graph.alt: Graph of a piecewise function f from x = -4 to x = 5: a parabola piece from the filled point (-4, 1) down to (-2, -1) and up toward an open circle at (1, 3.5), then a line from the filled point (1, 5) down to the filled point (5, 1). Notes beside it: f(1) = 5 is the filled dot; the open circle is not on the graph; the range is from -1 to 5; the line y = 2 meets the graph at x = 0 and x = 4.

fn-shifts.alt: The parabola y = x squared, dashed, with lowest point (0, 0), and the parabola y = (x - 2) squared + 1, solid, with lowest point (2, 1): the same shape moved 2 right and 1 up.
